name: Ore to Mahou no Koibito
source:
Me and My Magical Boyfriends stars Simba, a magician in training; searching for love. Using the Spellbook of Almagest in hopes of acquiring a boyfriend, he accidentally summons four men from different worlds. With inspections approaching within a month, if Simba doesn’t return them home in time, he may be forced to renounce his magicianship.

[From [url=http://baragamer.com/2013/03/04/me-and-my-magical-boyfriends-bara-game-is-free/]Baragamer.com[/url]]
translation:
《我和我的魔法男友》主演辛巴，一位正在接受训练的魔术师；寻找爱情。他使用《天文学大成》的魔法书希望能找到一个男朋友，却意外地召唤了四个来自不同世界的男人。一个月内检查即将来临，如果辛巴不及时将他们送回家，他可能会被迫放弃魔法师的职业。

[来自[url=http://baragamer.com/2013/03/04/me-and-my-magical-boyfriends-bara-game-is-free/]Baragamer.com[/url]]
